# evo-skillopt — llms.txt

> Text-space skill optimization for production LLM agents. A productized
> wrapper around the SkillOpt algorithm (arXiv:2605.23904, MIT) that
> exposes skill-file training as an HTTP service callable from any
> language. Train a Markdown behavior contract like a neural network —
> rollout, reflect, aggregate, select, update, gate — without touching
> model weights.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) so AI
agents and LLM-powered search can locate the project's canonical entry
points without crawling the whole repository.

## About

- **One sentence.** evo-skillopt is a self-hostable HTTP worker that
  evolves a bot's Markdown skill file against a held-out eval set, with
  git-tracked audit trails and inference-cost LLM calls.
- **Scope.** This repo is the OSS worker + examples + docs. The
  compounding advantage is the eval sets and evolved skills a user
  builds up in their own repo over time.
- **License.** MIT (this project) + MIT (vendored SkillOpt).

## HTTP API (what the service exposes)

Agent-discovery (unauthenticated GETs — served by the live worker at
its own root AND by the docs site at `site_url`):

- `GET  /`                          — service card JSON
- `GET  /health`                    — liveness
- `GET  /metrics`                   — Prometheus exposition (RED metrics; needs `[worker]` extras)
- `GET  /.well-known/agents.json`   — machine-readable capabilities manifest
- `GET  /.well-known/openapi.yaml`  — OpenAPI 3.1 contract
- `GET  /llms.txt`                  — this file
- `GET  /llms-full.txt`             — full self-contained LLM summary
- `GET  /AGENTS.md`                 — repo orientation for coding agents

Operational endpoints (bearer auth when `WORKER_TOKEN` is set):

- `POST /train`                     — one training pass; optional `rrss` overlay
- `POST /train/cascade`             — aggregate + gate a cascade of per-stage scores
- `POST /fitness/arm`               — reduce Acquire/Retain/Monetize signals to one fitness
- `GET  /bots/{slug}/skill`         — current skill (or `?version=X.Y.Z`)
- `GET  /bots/{slug}/history`       — versioned history with gate deltas
- `GET  /bots/{slug}/diff`          — unified diff: `?from=X.Y.Z&to=A.B.C`
- `POST /bots/{slug}/rollback`      — rollback current to `?to=X.Y.Z`
- `GET  /cost/models`               — known-model price registry (public)
- `POST /cost/estimate`             — pre-run token + dollar estimate per workload
- `GET  /jobs`                      — list async-queue jobs (filters: status, bot_id, limit, offset)
- `GET  /jobs/{id}`                 — status + result of one async job
- `POST /train` with `{"async": true}` — enqueue instead of running inline; returns 202 + job_id

Machine-readable contract: [`.well-known/openapi.yaml`](./.well-known/openapi.yaml) (OpenAPI 3.1).
Full endpoint docs: [worker/README.md](./worker/README.md).

## Source entry points

- [worker/skillopt_worker.py](./worker/skillopt_worker.py): HTTP bridge
- [worker/rrss_gate.py](./worker/rrss_gate.py): resilience-scored gate
- [worker/rrss_from_history.py](./worker/rrss_from_history.py): derive RRSS inputs from a run
- [worker/cascade.py](./worker/cascade.py): multi-stage skill pipeline gating
- [worker/arm_signals.py](./worker/arm_signals.py): lifecycle signal bucketing
- [scripts/train.py](./scripts/train.py): upstream SkillOpt training entrypoint
- [scripts/eval_only.py](./scripts/eval_only.py): single-skill evaluation

## For agents navigating this repo

See [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for a short orientation written for AI
coding agents — repo layout, how to run tests, what to leave untouched
(the vendored `skillopt/` directory), and the commit/branch conventions.
